results.title: Hurt (Nine Inch Nails song) - Wikipedia
results.content: In 2002, American country singer Johnny Cash covered the song for his final album during his lifetime, American IV: The Man Comes Around. Its accompanying video, featuring images from Cash's life and directed by Mark Romanek, was named the best video of the year by the Grammy Awards and CMA Awards, and the best video of all time by NME in July 2011. The single contains a cover of Depeche Mode's "Personal Jesus" as a B-side.
